sections.title: Objective type questions: each has two parts of 1 mark (true/false, match the columns, fill in the blanks or give reasons).

questions.q: Priya arranges flowers in a vase. Steps: (i) Fix the pin holder to the container and pour water until it covers the pin holder. (ii) Decide the shape of the arrangement. Missing step 1: ______. Missing step 2: ______ (iii) Cut the stems at different lengths, with the tallest branch 1½ times the width of the vase. (iv) Fill the gaps with leaves. Complete the missing steps.
questions.answer: Missing step 1 (after deciding the shape): choose flowers of different sizes and pluck them in the morning; cut stems under water. Missing step 2: arrange the tallest flower first and then the others in order of height, with bigger flowers at the bottom and buds at the top.

questions.q: Correct the following. (a) Flowers should be plucked in the evening. (b) An even number of flowers should be chosen. (c) Buds should be placed at the bottom.
questions.answer: (a) In the morning. (b) An odd number. (c) Buds go at the top, bigger flowers at the bottom.

questions.q: Fill in the blanks. (a) In an arrangement, green leaves add beauty, give a background and make it resemble ________. (b) A rangoli should use ________ colours next to each other.
questions.answer: (a) Nature. (b) Contrasting.

questions.q: True or False. (a) Oasis can be reused 2–4 times. (b) A pin holder should be rusty to hold stems.
questions.answer: (a) True. (b) False: it should be rust-free.

sections.title: Very short answer questions. Answer in 30–50 words.

questions.q: What is the role of twigs and leaves in a flower arrangement?
questions.answer: Twigs give a natural look and enhance the shape of the arrangement. Leaves fill gaps, give a background to flowers and resemble nature.

questions.q: What is a pin holder? Why is it used?
questions.answer: It is a heavy metal base fitted with closely spaced iron nails. It holds the flower and leaf stems in position in the vase.

questions.q: State two principles of flower arrangement.
questions.answer: The arrangement should be balanced, neither top-heavy nor lopsided. It should be in proportion to the room and the vase.

questions.q: Write two points on the importance of arranging things in an orderly manner at home.
questions.answer: Things can be found quickly, saving time and energy. The house looks neat and comfortable and gives a pleasant feeling.

questions.q: State two tips for making a good rangoli.
questions.answer: Select the design to suit the occasion and draw it in double lines. Use contrasting colours and fill evenly, pressing flat.

sections.title: Short answer questions. Answer in 50–80 words.

questions.q: Which three points should be kept in mind while hanging paintings on walls?
questions.answer: (i) Hang paintings according to size and space: big paintings on big walls or a group of small ones in an imaginary rectangle. (ii) Use spot lights and hang them straight and even. (iii) Colour of lamps should match the décor and paintings should not be crowded.

questions.q: Enumerate the principles of flower arrangement (three points).
questions.answer: (i) Size in proportion to the room and vase, and a balanced arrangement. (ii) Rhythm: the eye should travel smoothly, with flowers graded from blooms to buds. (iii) Plant material more important than the vase, with harmony of colours.

questions.q: Give five suggestions to beautify a room for guests (three of them).
questions.answer: (i) Arrange a flower vase in a corner or side table with an odd number of flowers. (ii) Keep furniture in proportion, adequate lighting and hang paintings straight. (iii) Place cushions and indoor plants and avoid clutter.

questions.q: Explain how a rangoli is made (three points).
questions.answer: (i) Select the design to suit the occasion and draw it with chalk in double lines. (ii) Fill with colours, flower petals or coloured sawdust using contrasting colours. (iii) Fill evenly, neaten the edges with a scale and fill the background.

sections.title: Long answer questions. Answer in 80–120 words.

questions.q: Explain the steps of making a flower arrangement.
questions.answer: (i) Collect the vase, pin holder or oasis, flowers, leaves and twigs. (ii) Fix the pin holder in the container and cover with water or soak the oasis. (iii) Decide the shape and choose flowers of different sizes. (iv) Cut stems at different lengths with the tallest 1½ times the vase width, and place the tallest first. (v) Put bigger flowers at the bottom, medium in the centre and buds at the top. (vi) Fill the gaps with leaves, hide the holder and place against a contrasting background.
